name: London
mandate: PrompTugal.news London: data, messaging and workflows that are useful to Londoners, from public official sources only, every fact with its source, date read and licence. The Tube strikes come first once a TfL source can be read.

extras.label: London's population, mid-2025
extras.value: 9,122,909 usual residents across 33 local authorities (the 32 London boroughs and the City of London), down from 9,149,646 at mid-2024. Largest: Croydon, 410,085. Smallest: the City of London, 15,631.
